messages: The leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000# seems to be looking for someone who could become his business partner.

The leatherworking master, #p401# of #m10003000#, is giving me a test to see if I'm worthy of becoming his partner. He said that one must have the proper strength and knowledge for leatherworking and asked me to defeat monsters around #m10003000# and #m10001000# to collect #b#t4000049##k.
I passed the test given by the leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000#. Could this mean that I, too, can stand proudly as a leatherworker of Maple World?
name: JM From tha Streetz Looking for a Partner
